title: woh waqt yaqeenan ayega
body:
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan AAayega
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula...
Kabhi Aye Haqeeqat e Muntazar
Nazar Aa Libas e Majaz Mein Ke Hazaron Sajday Tarap Rahe
Hain Meri Jabeen e Niaz Main
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega, Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega
Jab Hujjat e Daur Ke Hatho'n Mein
Ghazi Ka Alam Lehrayega
<<MINI>>
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega..(2)
Allahumma ajjil li waliyyi kal faraj(a.t.f.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jis Din Sajjad Ke Ashqo'n Ki
Tadaad Bataye Jayegi Aur un Ashqo'n Ke Badle Mein
Talwar Chalayi Jayegi
Us Sar Se Jism Juda Hoga..(2)
Talwar Se Jo Takrayega
<<MINI>>
Alam Lehrayega, Lehrayega
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega..(2)
Ya.. Mahdi!!
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Har Ek Mazloom Ki Aas Hai Yeh
Hujjat Ka Shams Tuloo Hoga Phir Shaam Jigar Se Utregi
Sajjad Ka Khatam Ruku Hoga Phir Noor e Aman Yu Phelay Ga..(2)
Har Zulm Ko Rondha Jaayega
<<MINI>>
Alam Lehrayega, Lehrayega
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega..(2)
Allahumma ajjil li waliyyi kal faraj(a.t.f.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dadi Ka Haq Woh Maange ga
Apni Talwar Ke Sath Kabhi
Jo Haath Ridaein Loot-te Hai
Kat Jayenge Woh Haath Sabhi
Tatheer Ke Ghar Ki Surat Phir..(2)
Koi Ghar Na Loota Jaayega
<<MINI>>
Alam Lehrayega, Lehrayega
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Abad Baqaiyya Tha Jis Jaa
Woh Roza Kaise Toota Hai
Kis Kis Ne Yaha'n Kaise Kaise
Sadaat Ke Ghar Ko Loota Hai
Talwar Batati Jayegi..(2)
Woh Khoon Bahata Jaayega
<<MINI>>
Alam Lehrayega, Lehrayega
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baaghi Ki Beti Jis Ne Bhi
Choti Bibi Ko Bola Tha
Namoos e Nabi Ko Raho'n Mein
Durro'n Se Jis Ne Maara Tha
Un Sab Ko Bana Kar Qaidi Wo..(2)
Bazaar e Shaam Mein Laayega
<<MINI>>
Alam Lehrayega, Lehrayega
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega..(2)
Ya.. Mahdi!!
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Phir Ehlebait Madine Mein
Aabad Karenge Ghar Apna Aur Lenge Bani Hashim Mil Kar
Kuch Parde Daro'n Ka Badla
Abbas Ki Chup Bhi Tootegi..(2)
Besher Bhi Teigh Uthayega
<<MINI>>
Alam Lehrayega, Lehrayega
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Gohar Mulko'n Ki Sarhad Se
Insaa’n Taqseem Nahi Hoga
Haan Naam Nehad Mazahib Mein
Qura’n Taqseem Nahi Hoga
Woh Adil Saari Duniya Ko..(2)
Ek Adl Ka Sheher Banayega
<<MINI>>
Alam Lehrayega, Lehrayega
Woh Waqt Yaqeenan Aayega..(2)
Ya.. Mahdi!!
Allahumma ajjil li waliyyi kal faraj(a.t.f.s.)
